observations: Photo 0 shows a large pile of used tires stacked in an outdoor yard, with many showing significant wear, cracks, and dirt. Some tires have yellow markings or numbers written on them.
Photo 1 shows more used tires, many of which are damaged, including one severely curled and another split in half. The ground is dusty and littered with debris.
In the background of both photos, racks of alloy wheels are visible, mostly silver or black with multi-spoke designs.
No brand names or model numbers are visible on any tire sidewall in either photo.
The tires appear to be of various sizes and conditions, with some showing deep tread wear and others being completely worn out or damaged.
The seller's text 'Belgium tyres dealers' is not visible in the photos and appears to be a claim without visual support.
